artifact_authenticity.evidence_summary: The committed bytes display FiscalBot's example-only disclaimer and placeholder receipt number, and their third-party authoring history confirms that this artifact is not an official AEAT publication byte.

official_source.document_id: AEAT IVA 2024 Manual, Chapter 9 Modelo 303 annex

official_base_derivation.comparison_summary: Mapped pages show 96.4-100% coordinate word agreement and only 0.37-0.73% normalized raster delta against the official annex. Boxes 108, 109, and 111 identify the 2024-late/2025 family; absence of 2026 box 112 prevents current-revision alignment.

pair_render.comparison_summary: All three plain and fillable pages render pixel-identically at 96 dpi; the fillable member adds empty AcroForm fields without changing the rendered base.

observations.value_observation: The text layer contains printed labels and box numbers; no populated taxpayer NIF, IBAN, email address, or AcroForm value was observed.

limitations: Third-party hosting, PDF branding, and document metadata do not establish AEAT provenance.
The candidate is retained byte-for-byte as downloaded; plain is only the source page's variant label.
A blank external layout does not ground populated-value placement.
